rule: break on year y if count(y) / count(prior non-zero year) > 3 or < 1/3 and max(count(y), count(prior)) >= 30; zero-count years flagged and never usable; usable window = longest run of consecutive non-zero years containing no break year after its first year (ties to the most recent run); coverage_ok(state, year) = year inside the usable window
